easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Activate Oko, Lorwyn Liege by putting 2 loyalty counter on it, giving Human Torch all creature types.
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcom triggers due to Oko, Lorwyn Liege, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Quicksmith Genius, causing you to draw a card and discard a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion
